title: Filtering the sale_items table by numbers · part 90

steps.title: Keep unit_price < 3356.82
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where unit_price is smaller than 3356.82.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is unit_price < 3356.82.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows unit_price < 3356.82
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE unit_price < 3356.82.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82;

steps.title: Filter then sort: unit_price < 3356.82
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82 ORDER BY unit_price LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE unit_price < 3356.82.
Add ORDER BY unit_price LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82 ORDER BY unit_price LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price < 3356.82 ORDER BY unit_price LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
